export function slugify(str: string): string {
  if (!str) return "";

  const ru: { [key: string]: string } = {
    'а': 'a', 'б': 'b', 'в': 'v', 'г': 'g', 'д': 'd', 
    'е': 'e', 'ё': 'yo', 'ж': 'zh', 'з': 'z', 'и': 'i', 
    'й': 'y', 'к': 'k', 'л': 'l', 'м': 'm', 'н': 'n', 
    'о': 'o', 'п': 'p', 'р': 'r', 'с': 's', 'т': 't', 
    'у': 'u', 'ф': 'f', 'х': 'h', 'ц': 'ts', 'ч': 'ch', 
    'ш': 'sh', 'щ': 'sch', 'ъ': '', 'ы': 'y', 'ь': '', 
    'э': 'e', 'ю': 'yu', 'я': 'ya'
  };

  return str
    .toLowerCase()
    .split('')
    .map(char => ru[char] || char) // Заменяем русские буквы
    .join('')
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '') // Убираем спецсимволы (кроме букв, цифр, пробела и дефиса)
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')     // Меняем пробелы на дефисы
    .replace(/-+/g, '-')      // Убираем дублирующиеся дефисы
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); // Убираем дефисы в начале и конце
}

  viber          String?
  
  foodPref       String? @map("food_pref")
  shoeSize       String? @map("shoe_size")
  clothesSize    String? @map("clothes_size")
  lifeJacketSize String? @map("life_jacket_size")
  inventory      String[]  @default([])

  totalTours Int     @default(0) @map("total_tours")
  totalKm    Float   @default(0) @map("total_km")

  watchLists    WatchList[]
  testResults   TestResult[]

// ✅ НОВАЯ ТАБЛИЦА: Центр Уведомлений / Логи (v2.0)
model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  memberId  String   @map("member_id") @db.Uuid
  member    MemberProfile @relation(fields: [memberId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  type      String   @default("info") // info, booking, bonus, system
  title     String?
  message   String
  link      String?  // Ссылка для перехода (например, /account/bookings/123)
  
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

 @@index([memberId, isRead])
  @@map("notifications")
}

model WatchList {
 id String @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid

  memberId String        @map("member_id") @db.Uuid
  member   MemberProfile @relation(fields: [memberId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  tourId String? @map("tour_id") @db.Uuid
  tour   Tour?   @relation(fields: [tourId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  categoryId String? @map("category_id") @db.Uuid
  category   TourCategory? @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  
  guideId String? @map("guide_id") @db.Uuid
  guide   Guide?  @relation(fields: [guideId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  notified  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  @@unique([memberId, tourId])
  @@unique([memberId, categoryId])
  @@unique([memberId, guideId])
  @@index([memberId])
  @@index([tourId])
  @@map("watch_list")
}

model FavoritePost {
  id        String   @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  memberId  String   @map("member_id") @db.Uuid
  postId    String   @map("post_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  member    MemberProfile @relation(fields: [memberId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  post      Blog          @relation(fields: [postId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([memberId, postId])
  @@index([memberId])
  @@index([postId])
  @@map("favorite_posts")
}

model TestResult {
  id String @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid

  memberId String        @map("member_id") @db.Uuid
  member   MemberProfile @relation(fields: [memberId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  testSlug String @map("test_slug")
  result   Json 

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  @@unique([memberId, testSlug])
  @@index([memberId])
  @@map("test_results")
}
